big_case.notes: Private damages suit by a Kansas family over property levied for a tax assessment the state courts later threw out, with the property itself returned in 2023. Respondent waived, no amici, no call for a response, denied without separate writing after one distribution. The retention-of-seized-property split the petition gestures at has some doctrinal salience, but this vehicle carried none of it: intermediate state appellate decision, damages-only posture, and a Fifth Amendment framing no circuit on the cited split has adopted.
